display.purpose: Largest in-tool voice: preview state titles, catalog specimen headings.

title.purpose: Object names and primary row emphasis.

body.purpose: Default UI text, tree rows, field values.

icon.purpose: Material Symbols Outlined glyphs across the editor.

shadows.name: elevation-1
shadows.purpose: Floating layers: menus, popovers, dialogs, tooltips, grabber pills.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most decisive action (e.g. a confirming Save).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:32px; padding:0 12px; border:none; border-radius:100px; background:#01699b; color:#fff; font:600 13px Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#004b73; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(1,105,155,0.30); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default editor action-bar CTA (Publish, Send To QA, Save).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:32px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.22); border-radius:100px; background:#fcf8f8; color:#1c1b1b; font:600 13px Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#f7f3f2; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(1,105,155,0.30); }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Icon-only tool action with an instant tooltip (CSS, JSON-LD, Settings).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:32px; height:32px; border:none; border-radius:100px; background:transparent; color:#1c1b1b; cursor:pointer; transition:background 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:#ebe7e7; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(1,105,155,0.30); }

components.name: Panel Header (Eyebrow)
components.description: Panel/section title: 11px uppercase eyebrow, muted. Peers look identical.
components.css: .ds-panel-head { display:flex; align-items:center; padding:8px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12); background:#fcf8f8; } .ds-eyebrow { font:600 11px Inter,sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#76777a; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Quiet outlined well: surface fill, subtle hairline, blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height:32px; padding:0 12px; width:220px; border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06); border-radius:8px; background:#fcf8f8; color:#1c1b1b; font:400 13px Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#76777a; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:#8fbdd5; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(1,105,155,0.30); }

components.name: Structure Tree Row (selected)
components.description: 28px row; selection shown by fill AND a left blue accent bar.
components.html: Premium
components.css: .ds-tree-row { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; height:28px; padding:0 8px 0 12px; border-radius:8px; background:#dbeaf3; color:#1c1b1b; font:400 13px Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-accent { position:absolute; left:0; top:50%; width:2px; height:16px; transform:translateY(-50%); border-radius:100px; background:#01699b; } .ds-chev { color:#76777a; transform:rotate(90deg); } .ds-label { white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Accessibility Semáforo
components.description: Live tri-state a11y readout (Pass/Review/Fail → green/amber/red) with score + locale.
components.html: Pass100/100US·en-US
components.css: .ds-a11y { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:30px; padding:0 8px; border-radius:12px; border:1px solid rgba(20,108,67,0.22); background:#e6f2ea; color:#146c43; } .ds-a11y-body { display:inline-flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; gap:1px; line-height:1; } .ds-a11y-top { display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:4px; } .ds-a11y-status { font:700 9px Inter,sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-a11y-score { font:600 13px Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-a11y-max { font-weight:500; opacity:0.65; } .ds-a11y-locale { font:400 9px Inter,sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.04em; text-transform:uppercase; opacity:0.8; }

components.name: Instant Tooltip
components.description: Dark instant tooltip for icon-only CTAs and the nav rail; no native-title delay.
components.css: .ds-tip { position:relative; display:inline-flex; } .ds-tip::after { content:attr(data-tip); position:absolute; top:calc(100% + 4px); left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-4px); padding:4px 8px; background:#2f3133; color:#fff; font:500 12px Inter,sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; border-radius:8px; box-shadow:0 1px 3px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.15),0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.3); opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity 120ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; z-index:30; } .ds-tip:hover::after, .ds-tip:focus-within::after { opacity:1; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }

narrative.overview: Iceberg's editor is a calm, precise authoring surface where the work — the live Peacock page — is the hero and the chrome recedes around it. Built on Eos (Material 3) in a warm-neutral light scheme, with a single brand accent (Iceberg Blue) reserved for meaning. It is an Operate-mode tool: scanability, consistency, and a stable spine outrank expression; personality lives in precise details. Hierarchy is tonal, not bordered — a short warm-neutral surface ladder carries depth so panels read as inset sheets, flat at rest, with shadow only where a layer truly floats. This system dresses the authoring chrome only; the Peacock customer preview is a separate, isolated world.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral M3 surfaces with a single blue accent used sparingly.
Tone-and-space hierarchy over borders; hairlines only where needed.
Flat at rest; shadow only for floating layers.

rules.name: The Iceberg Blue Rule
rules.body: The blue appears only on action, selection, links, tabs, and focus — never as a decorative fill. Its rarity is what makes it read as actionable.

rules.name: The Two-System Rule
rules.body: These tokens dress the authoring chrome only. The customer preview is Peacock's world; it must never adopt these tokens, and this chrome must never adopt Peacock's.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Panel/section titles that are peers look identical — 11px semibold uppercase, +0.06em, muted — so PAGES, STRUCTURE, and PROPERTIES read as one level.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for a tone step or spacing before a border, and a border before a shadow. Resting surfaces never carry a shadow; a shadow means this floats.

rules.name: The Pill-CTA Rule
rules.body: Interactive buttons are fully pill; content containers are softly rounded (8–16px). The two never swap.

dos: Do separate hierarchy with the surface ladder + spacing before reaching for a border, and a border before a shadow.
Do reserve Iceberg Blue (#01699b) for action, selection, and focus only.
Do keep editor action-bar CTAs secondary; use a filled primary only for the single decisive action.
Do render panel/section titles as 11px uppercase eyebrows.
Do use Material Symbols for every icon.
Do signal selection with a redundant cue (fill + accent bar), never color alone.
donts: Don't nest a bordered container inside another bordered container.
Don't let the editor chrome resemble the Peacock customer UI, or import Peacock tokens into it (and vice-versa).
Don't use pure #ffffff body text or pure-black borders; use the token roles.
Don't put a shadow on a resting surface.
Don't introduce a second accent hue.
